type: static web app with optional Supabase sync
current_goal: Tablet app for a book booth: price lookup, inventory, promotions, payment info and book orders.

main_files.index.html: DOM structure for customer screens, admin dashboard, dialogs and forms.
main_files.app.js: Application state, localStorage/Supabase persistence, rendering, event handling, barcode scanner, search and backup.
main_files.config.js: Optional Supabase credentials and table names.
main_files.vendor/pdfjs/: Local PDF.js copy used for invoice PDF text extraction without relying on CDN loading.
main_files.supabase-schema.sql: Database schema for books, book_orders, settings and sales.

data_storage.local: localStorage keys: bookStand.books, bookStand.orders, bookStand.sales, bookStand.cart, bookStand.invoices, bookStand.settings, bookStand.backups
data_storage.remote: Supabase tables: books, book_orders, settings, sales
data_storage.export: Admin export button downloads JSON containing books, orders, invoices, settings and backups.

important_notes: Do not copy data from the user's Base44 app; use structure only.
Customer design should stay close in feeling to the user's Base44 page while keeping this app's business name: נאמן ספרים.

Supabase books.barcode is now intended to be nullable so imported books can start without barcodes; run the updated supabase-schema.sql on a real Supabase project before relying on barcode-less remote imports.

The 2026-07-15 cart update adds sales.quantity, sales.total_price and sales.purchase_group_id. The app has a fallback for old sales tables, but run supabase-schema.sql before relying on grouped remote sales analysis.

The Google Sheet import updated the current browser's local app data. If the user switches browser/device or clears localStorage before Supabase sync is configured, the imported inventory will need to be imported again from outputs/imported-books-from-google.tsv.
Invoice files are currently stored in browser localStorage as data URLs. For real use with many/larger files, move files to Supabase Storage and keep only metadata/file URLs in the database.
The invoice detector should keep marking uncertain OCR-needed files for review rather than guessing supplier/amount from corrupted text.
